dedupe_keys.name: cod a dataset of commercial building occupancy traces

description: The Commercial Occupancy Dataset team publishes nine months of room-level occupancy traces from one office building. Zenodo supplies a ZIP under CC BY-SA 4.0. The deposit reports more than 90,000 entrance and exit events for two conference rooms and one open-plan room, collected through depth-imaging sensors at four doorways. It describes separate CSV files for each monitored room. These traces can calibrate occupant schedules, demand profiles and human-in-the-loop heating or cooling simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this office collection. Coverage is three rooms in a single building, not a representative sample of commercial buildings or observed HVAC demand. A limitation is that counts are sensor estimates; occlusion, doorway configuration and movement between rooms can affect occupancy reconstruction. The date range and event completeness would need checking inside the files. No ZIP was downloaded or sensor accuracy independently measured.
